uncertainty: Silhouette trace uncertainty approximately 1-2 native pixels; chrome glare blurs some edges.
Front illustration has a slight turn: left chrome rim is wider than right, and W is shifted right.
Symmetric model construction must be compared against these RAW paths, not against an edited symmetric target.
Back head/chrome-neck join is partly ambiguous at y261-266; neck is excluded.
Back and front head H/W ratios differ in the drawing; one uniform scale per view is allowed, not independent x/y stretch.
This is NOT a true side view: a complete eye and substantial front panel remain visible.
Camera yaw and head depth cannot both be uniquely recovered from this drawing.
Do not call a 90-degree model projection matched or approved from this view.

measurement_method: Manual source-pixel contours; front/back uniformly scaled by head width, quarter uniformly scaled by vertical extent to preserve foreshortening. No anisotropic scaling, pose fitting, or perspective warping.

comparison.tolerance_status: Review aid reflecting the small reference; not owner acceptance.

unmeasured: Null values belong to deferred phases or lack a calibrated orthographic reference. They are not zero.

construction_assumptions.symmetry: Average left/right radial contours about each measured head center. Report residual against raw source contours.
construction_assumptions.shared_outline: Equal-weight front/back radial contours: one orthographic solid cannot have two different front/back silhouettes. Both raw source residuals are reported.
construction_assumptions.eye_placement: Raw measured projected eye shapes/centers take priority over forced symmetry. The slight turn in the source shifts the pair from the dome center; canonical orthographic facial symmetry remains unverified.
construction_assumptions.head_depth_status: Provisional construction value, not a measurement; no true 90-degree source exists in the local sheet.
construction_assumptions.quarter_camera_status: Illustrative, uncalibrated; excluded from quantitative acceptance.
construction_assumptions.surface_relief: Panel/eye relief is provisional; the available drawings constrain projection more strongly than hidden depth.
